captured_against: SYNTHETIC — derived from simple-text.ndjson by type-mutation
description: Synthetic fixture: a captured init event with its type field mutated to an invented value (cosmic_ray_hit). Used by Phase 3 PRS-03 to verify the parser's lenient fallback yields {type:'unknown', raw: <original>} without throwing.

raw._comment: The raw field should hold the full original JSON object from event-unknown.ndjson. Phase 3's parser test asserts this shape: {type:'unknown', raw:{type:'cosmic_ray_hit', ...rest}}.
